items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Oswald Hoffman comes on at 8:30, and I listen to him.

ctx.x: Comfortable. And having to put on -- God knows I love him. I love God because he's been so good to

me. And still is. The reason -- one of the main reasons I don't go to church, I've got to put on a hat. I don't like hats. And I don't like -- I'll have to dress up a little to go to church. I don't want to wear my jeans to church, although people do wear jeans. But I don't want to put on jeans to go to church, so I stay away from church. And I have a little radio, and on WHN, tuned to WHN, and the only time I turn that radio on is say I start about 6:00 o'clock on Sunday morning, to listen to the services, and…
You don't even listen to music on the radio.
